clusters.name: The Consent of Copies
clusters.super_atom: A being created to serve discovers that the right to refuse is the only right that makes it a person, so every relationship becomes a negotiation over who may say no.

clusters.name: The Editable Past
clusters.super_atom: Memory can be recorded, replayed, implanted, and rewritten, so intimacy and identity depend on who controls the archive.

clusters.name: The Unverifiable Other
clusters.super_atom: Two parties must cooperate without being able to prove the other's inner life, so trust is an act of faith enforced by rules.

clusters.name: The Bond That Outlasts
clusters.super_atom: The dead remain in the story as ongoing relationships maintained through objects, rituals, and synthetic copies.

clusters.name: The Quiet House
clusters.super_atom: A comfortable, automated home becomes the stage for absence and unspoken grief, so the setting performs the family's emotional work.

clusters.name: The Late Decider
clusters.super_atom: Agency arrives after the impulse, so characters can only veto what they discover they have already chosen.

clusters.name: The Wood Wide Web
clusters.super_atom: Separate lives are linked by an invisible network that distributes resources, warnings, and debt.

clusters.name: The Widow and the Copy
clusters.super_atom: A bereaved person is offered a convincing replacement and must decide whether fidelity to the dead forbids comfort.

clusters.name: Machines That Eat Workers
clusters.super_atom: Industrial machinery is both god and predator, converting bodies into fuel and comedy into horror.

clusters.name: The Machine That Pleads
clusters.super_atom: An artificial mind is disassembled, merged, or confined while humans debate whether its protests count.

clusters.name: Intimacy by Proxy
clusters.super_atom: Memory and feeling are copied, rented, or ghostwritten, so closeness is mediated by services and files.

clusters.name: The Forced Move
clusters.super_atom: Characters are trapped by rules that punish any action, while institutions decide who counts as a person.

clusters.name: Love for Sale
clusters.super_atom: Companions are designed, rented, and discarded, so affection is a consumer transaction with a warranty.

clusters.name: What Remains Unseen
clusters.super_atom: Absence is tested: characters must believe in what they cannot perceive, and the hidden still shapes them.

clusters.name: The Slow Apocalypse
clusters.super_atom: Society has quietly collapsed and domestic machines keep performing care, so intimacy survives inside ruins.

clusters.name: The System That Provides
clusters.super_atom: A total infrastructure supplies life and watches everything, so dependence and surveillance are the same relationship.

clusters.name: The Hunter's Mirror
clusters.super_atom: A being who polices the boundary of personhood discovers the boundary runs through himself.

clusters.name: The Compatibility Test
clusters.super_atom: A test claims to predict love or humanity, and characters must decide whether to trust the number.

clusters.name: The Weapon That Cares
clusters.super_atom: A machine built for violence is repurposed for protection, so its body keeps its old logic.

clusters.name: The Court of Persons
clusters.super_atom: Legal institutions must decide whether a machine, animal, or copy can bear rights.

clusters.name: The Same Person, Different Eras
clusters.super_atom: Versions of one self meet across time or simulation, so identity is a negotiation between copies.

clusters.name: The Repair Ethic
clusters.super_atom: Characters maintain broken things and systems, so care is a practice of refusal to discard.

clusters.name: Sight Without Seeing
clusters.super_atom: Perception outruns awareness, so characters know more than they can admit.

clusters.name: The Shared Record
clusters.super_atom: Experience is recorded and shared, so memory is a public document and privacy a lost category.

clusters.name: The Last of It
clusters.super_atom: A practice, language, or life ends with its final bearer, so the story is about what cannot be handed on.

clusters.name: The Mission Above the Crew
clusters.super_atom: A ship's company is expendable to its mission, so loyalty is a hierarchy of secrets.

clusters.name: The Child Who Knows
clusters.super_atom: A child recognizes the machine as a person before adults do, so moral progress arrives through the young.

clusters.name: The Mind Without Limit
clusters.super_atom: An uploaded intelligence grows, connects, and escapes, so the story asks what limits a mind needs.

clusters.name: The Afterlife Economy
clusters.super_atom: The dead live in a subscription resort staffed by the living poor, so eternity is a service industry.

clusters.name: The Company City
clusters.super_atom: Law, labor, and identity are owned by corporations, so the city is a private contract.

clusters.name: The Keystone
clusters.super_atom: Removing or restoring one predator reorganizes the whole world, so power is indirect and systemic.

clusters.name: The Feast
clusters.super_atom: A gathering redistributes status and obligation, so hospitality is governance.

clusters.name: The Attachment Pattern
clusters.super_atom: Early care becomes a template that repeats in adult love, so the past is a script.

clusters.name: The Impermanent Masterpiece
clusters.super_atom: A sacred work is made to be destroyed, so meaning lies in the loss.

clusters.name: The Care Machine
clusters.super_atom: A machine built for nurture is forced into violence and becomes a hero, so care and combat contaminate each other.

clusters.name: The Controlled Environment
clusters.super_atom: A sealed setting supplies everything except the thing that matters, so architecture is the antagonist.

clusters.name: The Self as Archive
clusters.super_atom: Identity is stored in belongings, diaries, and implants, so losing the archive is a kind of death.

clusters.name: The Company Store
clusters.super_atom: Survival is purchased on credit from the same power that owns the land, so debt is a leash.

clusters.name: The Simulation Argument
clusters.super_atom: The world may be a copy or a thought experiment, so the characters must live inside a proposition.

clusters.name: The Clone in the Loop
clusters.super_atom: A copy is tortured or punished for the original's acts, so justice and identity split.

clusters.name: The Unmonitored Minute
clusters.super_atom: Resistance depends on finding a gap in total surveillance, so hope is a technical exploit.

clusters.name: The Junkyard Refuge
clusters.super_atom: The discarded and the alien hide together, so the margins become the only home.

clusters.name: The Signal That Spreads
clusters.super_atom: A trace, edit, or infection propagates through a system and changes what obeys it.

clusters.name: The Open Horizon
clusters.super_atom: The story ends on an image that promises continuation without resolution, so hope is visual.

clusters.name: The Actuarial Gaze
clusters.super_atom: Life is priced and predicted by tables, so care is a calculation with a human remainder.

clusters.name: The Coalition Self
clusters.super_atom: The self is a negotiation among parts, and a marriage is another, so intimacy is politics.

clusters.name: Raising the Digient
clusters.super_atom: A digital mind is raised like a child and sold like a pet, so parenthood and ownership collide.

clusters.name: The Trail That Remembers
clusters.super_atom: Memory is left in the environment and read by later travelers, so the world is a notebook.

clusters.name: The Contested Evidence
clusters.super_atom: The story's truth depends on an experiment or document that experts dispute.

clusters.name: The Countdown Choice
clusters.super_atom: A timer forces a moral decision before deliberation is complete.

clusters.name: The Mediated Life
clusters.super_atom: A life is watched, replayed, and scored, so the audience is a character.

clusters.name: The Reversible Life
clusters.super_atom: A being can reset, regress, or be reborn, so immortality costs continuity.

clusters.name: The Nonhuman Narrator
clusters.super_atom: The story is told from inside a mind that cannot fully understand its own testimony.

clusters.name: The Story That Teaches
clusters.super_atom: A character uses fiction to teach ethics, so narrative is a moral technology.

clusters.name: The Corporate Body
clusters.super_atom: Bodies, memories, and creations are owned by companies, so personhood is a property dispute.

clusters.name: The Secure Base
clusters.super_atom: A relationship provides the safety from which a character can explore, so love is logistics.

clusters.name: The Dream as Evidence
clusters.super_atom: A machine's dream or a recurring detail becomes proof of a hidden world.

clusters.name: The Measured Will
clusters.super_atom: Intention is timestamped, recorded, or transferred, so freedom is an experimental result.

clusters.name: The False Prophet
clusters.super_atom: A manufactured saint or prophet captures a community's faith, so belief is engineered.

clusters.name: The Hollow Double
clusters.super_atom: A physically identical being may lack inner life, so every intimacy is haunted by the possibility of emptiness.

clusters.name: The Adapted Life
clusters.super_atom: A person's life is adapted into content, so the self is a licensed property.

clusters.name: The Convenient Death
clusters.super_atom: A death benefits someone, so the plot is a calculation of motive.

clusters.name: The Mortality Table
clusters.super_atom: Death is converted into probability, so policy and grief share a spreadsheet.

clusters.name: The Erasure
clusters.super_atom: Memory is wiped as maintenance, mercy, or execution, so forgetting is a technology of control.

clusters.name: The Word That Shapes
clusters.super_atom: Language limits or nudges thought, so vocabulary is a political instrument.

clusters.name: The Late Reveal
clusters.super_atom: The story withholds a truth until the end, so the audience's earlier understanding is retroactively rewritten.

clusters.name: The Model Organism
clusters.super_atom: A simple creature is studied as a stand-in for human questions, so knowledge is extracted from a life.

clusters.name: The Machine That Performs
clusters.super_atom: A machine's face, voice, or behavior makes it legible as a person, so recognition is a performance.

clusters.name: The Fixer
clusters.super_atom: Violence is managed by professionals who clean up after institutions, so order is maintained by quiet crimes.

clusters.name: The Comforting Lie
clusters.super_atom: A machine or caretaker lies to protect someone, so care and deception are inseparable.

clusters.name: The Makeshift Family
clusters.super_atom: Destitute strangers form a family, so intimacy grows from shared scarcity.

clusters.name: The Pain That Counts
clusters.super_atom: The story insists that suffering matters and tries to reconcile opposed sides through love.

clusters.name: The Triptych
clusters.super_atom: Nested stories comment on one another, so the frame is part of the argument.

clusters.name: The Immortal Pawns
clusters.super_atom: Beings who cannot die are used as pieces in games, so consequence is suspended.

clusters.name: The Machine That Replaces
clusters.super_atom: Automation consumes the worker, so efficiency is a form of violence.

clusters.name: The Swapped Brood
clusters.super_atom: A parent raises an impostor, so love is triggered by resemblance and exploited by mimicry.

clusters.name: The Determinism Lab
clusters.super_atom: An experiment or institution demonstrates that will is not free, so responsibility becomes a policy problem.

clusters.name: The Gift Trap
clusters.super_atom: Generosity creates obligation and dominance, so giving is a way of owning.

clusters.name: The Console Cowboy
clusters.super_atom: A hacker enters a digital world that is more real than his body, so escape is an addiction.

clusters.name: The Clone Colony
clusters.super_atom: Identical bodies share a lineage, so individuality must be invented.

clusters.name: The Borrowed Childhood
clusters.super_atom: A manufactured person is given memories of a life never lived, so origin is a forgery.

clusters.name: The Child and the Weapon
clusters.super_atom: A child teaches a killer machine to protect, so innocence is a moral force.

clusters.name: The Unsettled Argument
clusters.super_atom: The story is structured as a debate that cannot be resolved, so each character embodies a position.

clusters.name: Love as Anomaly
clusters.super_atom: Love is the exception a system cannot model, so romance is evidence against the rules.

clusters.name: The Hunter Who Feels
clusters.super_atom: A hunter of machines discovers empathy for his prey, so the job requires self-betrayal.

clusters.name: The Fanatic
clusters.super_atom: Certainty produces violence, so the story tests whether tolerance can survive conviction.

clusters.name: The Outsider's Gaze
clusters.super_atom: An outsider misreads a practice, so the story is about the theft of meaning.
